mapper.select: SELECT opp_id AS id,opp_nm AS name,cust_clnt_id AS "customerId",part_id AS "partId",sales_step_cd AS stage, win_prbl_rt AS probability,prbl_manual_yn AS "manualProbability",expct_amt AS amount, substring(bgn_plan_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(bgn_plan_ym,5,2) AS "startMonth",ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType", expct_prd_mcnt::int AS months,work_plc_addr AS workplace,rmrk AS memo,opp_stat_cd AS status, expct_prft_rt AS "profitRate",aprv_stat_cd AS "approvalStatus",aprv_prft_rt AS "approvedProfitRate", rslt_dt AS "resultDate",lose_rsn_cd AS "lossReasonCode",lose_memo AS "lossMemo",proj_id AS "projectId",reg_user_id AS "registeredBy" FROM tb_sl_opp WHERE opp_id=#{id}

SELECT need_sn::int AS "needSn",job_cd AS "jobCode",grade_cd AS "gradeCode",need_cnt::int AS count, substring(bgn_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(bgn_ym,5,2) AS "startMonth",prd_mcnt::int AS months, mon_mm::text AS "monthlyMm",expct_uprc::text AS "expectedRate" FROM tb_sl_opp_need WHERE opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY need_sn
SELECT tent_id::text AS id,dev_id AS "developerId",tent_stat_cd AS status,proc_dttm AS "processedAt" FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn WHERE opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY tent_id
mapper.sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'opportunity',(SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM tb_sl_opp o WHERE o.opp_id=#{id}), 'needs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(n) ORDER BY n.need_sn) FROM tb_sl_opp_need n WHERE n.opp_id=#{id}), 'tentatives',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.tent_id) FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t WHERE t.opp_id=#{id}), 'approvals',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.hist_sn) FROM tb_sl_aprv_hist a WHERE a.opp_id=#{id}), 'codes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code) FROM tb_sy_code c), 'groups',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.code_grp_id) FROM tb_sy_code_grp c), 'standards',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.std_cd,s.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_sy_oper_std s), 'developers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.dev_id) FROM tb_hr_dev d), 'prices',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.dev_id,p.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_hr_dev_prc p), 'states',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.dev_id,s.stat_sn) FROM tb_hr_dev_stat s), 'payroll',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.pay_ym,p.dev_id) FROM tb_hr_mon_pay p), 'projects',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.proj_id) FROM tb_pj_proj p), 'parts',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.proj_id,p.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_pj_proj_part p), 'partStandards',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.part_id,p.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_bs_part_std p), 'assignments',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.asgn_id) FROM tb_pj_asgn a), 'history',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.asgn_id,a.hist_sn) FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist a), 'months',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.asgn_id,m.input_ym) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m), 'costs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.cost_ym,c.dev_id,c.proj_id,c.asgn_id) FROM tb_co_mon_cost c), 'turnkey',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.proj_id,t.dstrb_step_cd,t.row_sn,t.dstrb_ym) FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb t), 'closes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.close_ym) FROM tb_cl_close c) )::text
mapper.select: SELECT max(pay_ym) FROM tb_hr_mon_pay WHERE pay_ym<=#{month}
SELECT DISTINCT ON (std_cd) std_cd AS code,std_val AS value FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY std_cd,aply_bgn_ym DESC

SELECT c.code_grp_id AS "group",c.code,c.add_val2 AS "defaultRate" FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code

SELECT key FROM ( SELECT 'DEV:'||dev_id AS key FROM tb_hr_dev UNION SELECT 'ASGN:'||asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn UNION SELECT 'PROJECT:'||proj_id FROM tb_pj_proj UNION SELECT 'PAY:'||pay_ym FROM tb_hr_mon_pay UNION SELECT 'PART:'||part_id FROM tb_bs_part UNION SELECT 'code-group:'||code_grp_id FROM tb_sy_code_grp UNION SELECT 'operating-standards:'||std_cd FROM tb_sy_oper_std ) s ORDER BY key
SELECT opp_id FROM tb_sl_opp WHERE opp_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sl_tent_asgn SET tent_stat_cd=#{status},proc_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE tent_id=CAST(#{id} AS numeric) AND opp_id=#{opportunityId} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(max(hist_sn),0)::int FROM tb_sl_aprv_hist WHERE opp_id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='LOSE_RSN' AND c.code=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y')
